data.value: Will the founder of the Tidepool app post a public response within one week to the viral thread accusing the company of deleting critical reviews?

A viral thread on social media accuses Tidepool of deleting critical reviews. The thread has two million views and includes screenshots that appear genuine. The founder has not yet posted any public response.

data.content: The founder knows that some critical reviews were indeed taken down, as confirmed privately by the head of support. They have received emails from two journalists requesting comment. They are considering whether and how to respond publicly to the viral thread.
